name: toyota-maintenance-cockpit
description: Service-advisor maintenance cockpit: Xtime/Airtable JSONL artifacts -> SQLite lookup DB -> Fastify API -> React UI. Read-only, offline customer lookup.

scripts.etl: npm run build -w etl && node etl/dist/build-db.js
scripts.etl:fixtures: npm run build -w etl && node etl/dist/build-db.js --data-dir fixtures --out fixtures/tmc-fixture.db
scripts.api: npm run build -w server && node server/dist/index.js
scripts.test: npm run build -w etl && npm run test -w etl && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w etl && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.sync:airtable: npm run build -w etl --silent && node etl/dist/sync-airtable.js
scripts.seed:mappings: npm run build -w etl --silent && node etl/dist/seed-mappings.js
